corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez 3rd person feminine singular perfective verb is ሰምዐት (with 1st-order ዐ), which matches the round printed glyph.
The printed glyph has the shorter right leg of 4th-order ባ (ባልኩ ጊዜ, 'at the time I say/command').
The word at the end of Column 3 Line 40 wraps onto the next page (ቷን) to form እኅቷን ('her sister', translating the Ge'ez እኅታ in v. 28). Visually the glyphs are እኅ, not አላ.
